SLOOP for the M-Vave SMK-37

SLOOP 2.8.1 with USB audio stems, stem punch-ins and sequencer effects. Chrome or Edge, over USB.

Back up first. Before the first install, make a full 1 MiB flash backup of your keyboard: its calibration, Bluetooth pairing and key_mac are its own and no package contains them. How to back up. Unofficial firmware, not affiliated with or endorsed by M-Vave. No warranty.

Install: pick your model

SMK-37 Eliteidentity SMK-37 Elite SMK-37 Proalso the Starrykey 37 Play MKE-P37identity MKE-P37

The installer checks that the package matches your keyboard before it writes anything. Your projects, presets, samples and settings are kept. To go back to the stock firmware, use M-Vave's own updater (M-UPGRADE).
